<thought>Analyzed the mass spectrum: a dominant peak at m/z 193.11 with a series of decreasing peaks at +1, +2, +3, … Da. This pattern matches the multinomial isotopic distribution of carbon (13C) in a molecule containing many carbon atoms, which produces a characteristic envelope of M, M+1, M+2, etc. No distinct two‑peak patterns (e.g., Cl or Br) or a strong M+2 peak (~4 % of M) indicative of sulfur are present. Therefore, the only element that can be definitively identified from the observed isotopic envelope is carbon. 

<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
